title: UK Treasury risk assessment cites shell-company investigation 'Operation Hammerhead' and North Korean IT workers, per VOA Korea
date_note: VOA Korea says the Treasury released the report on the 23rd, without naming the month; the page gives no earlier day.
geo_basis: UK Treasury, country stated by source; London assumed as seat of government
summary: VOA Korea reports that the UK Treasury's 2026 National Risk Assessment of Proliferation Financing, released on the 23rd, presents results of 'Operation Hammerhead'. VOA says the report links UK-registered companies to North Korean sanctions evasion and cybercrime, and assesses it is 'almost certain' that North Korean IT workers using fake identities target UK firms.
plain: VOA Korea reports a UK Treasury assessment links UK-registered firms to North Korean sanctions evasion and cybercrime.
exec: Per VOA Korea, the UK Treasury says North Korean IT workers using fake identities are almost certainly targeting UK firms.

evidence.quote: 영국 등록 법인이 북한 제재 회피와 사이버 범죄 연루 인물들과 연결된 실제 수사 사례를 처음으로 제시했습니다

validation.note: Only VOA Korea was read; the Treasury report itself was not found.
